properties.name: Robinson Lab — Nano-neurotechnology
properties.description:
**Jacob T. Robinson** — Rice University, Houston, TX (US)

Uses semiconductor nanofabrication and genetic engineering to build electronic, photonic, and magnetic interfaces to the brain. Co-authored a magnetoelectric backscatter communication system for bioelectronic implants achieving <0.3 pJ/bit and <1e-6 bit error rate at 55 mm range with 10 mm misalignment tolerance, demonstrated transmitting cardiac signals from a beating heart in a porcine model. PI Jacob T. Robinson is also co-founder/CEO of Motif Neurotech (brain-computer interface for mental health disorders).

[[https://www.robinsonlab.com/|Group website]]

Category: Neuroscience Lab · Smallest demonstrated: unknown
